market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. Oil at $100+ and rising yields create stagflationary pressure. Dow -400-475 pts signals risk-off. Fed rate hike risk next week if oil sustains $100. Treasury buyback failure signals fiscal credibility concerns. Expect continued volatility and sector rotation into energy/defensives.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive. AI capex supercycle (OpenAI $750B, AMD/Qualcomm strength) supports tech earnings through 2027. Trade fragmentation creates structural winners in domestic supply chains. Energy transition (EU carbon reform, South Africa refining) offers multi-year themes. Key risk: prolonged oil shock triggering recession.
